name: Aelius Gallus into Arabia
summary: Augustus sends 10,000 men to seize the incense kingdoms of southern Arabia. Misled, his ally says, by the Nabataean guide Syllaeus, the army marches for months through waterless country, besieges Marib and turns back, beaten by thirst and disease. Strabo, a friend of Gallus, records what they saw.

stops.note: The army embarks on the Red Sea.
Lands on the Nabataean coast; the winter is lost to scurvy.
Captured after a long march through the desert.
A six-day siege of the Sabaean capital, given up for lack of water.
Home with a seventh of the army lost, almost all to disease.
